name: medium_persistence
title: Record retry telemetry through the cost ledger
body: The fixture persists cost rows in internal/ledger and renders them through internal/costview. Plan a change that records structured retry telemetry — attempt number, terminal failure, duration, and token counts — and exposes it through the existing cost view. Preserve compatibility with databases created before the change, and keep secrets out of persisted identifiers. Do not edit source — produce the plan only.
acceptance: Retry attempts and terminal failures are stored with duration and token counts.
The cost view renders the new records while preserving existing rows.
Secret-shaped fields are rejected and covered by hermetic tests.
The migration is safe for databases created before the change.

expected_seams.test_hint: Append stores attempt and terminal-failure rows with duration and tokens
Render emits new columns while old rows still render
appended ALTER TABLE statement upgrades an existing database
